The echo edge is written down both ways, so a closed ring of 144 clones produces a signature the ferrous analysis flags immediately. Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
